notes.title: Migration To Unity Engine Update!
notes.content:
As you may know, this game was previously created using RPG Maker MZ. However, we started migrating the game to Unity Engine in April. Obviously, RPG Maker and Unity are very different, and we will undoubtedly face numerous challenges when rebuilding this game using the Unity engine.

But as you can see, it is definitely worth it to move to unity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659562/30c8097cbc7cc4882e1c7deae17d61d243735b47.png

First, I'd want to demonstrate the difference between RPG Maker MZ Renderer and Unity Engine Renderer. The Unity version is more clearer and has smoother animation than RPG Maker MZ.

While we are not able to recreate 100% of the features on the RPG Maker MZ, we are able to replicate almost all of the features from the previous engine to the new one, and even improve on it!

Today, we'd like to share some screenshots from the Unity Engine-powered game.

notes.title: System Requirements Update & Lite Version Announced
notes.content:
Hello, based on current CBT run, especially on Batch 4 and Batch 5 testing, We decide to update the Minimum and Reccomended specification for the game, due to report of the game slowdown and lag even on an system supposedly can run the game.

Minimum System Requirements now.


 CPU: AMD Athlon 200GE (Before AMD A8 5550M APU) or Intel Core i3-6100 (Before Intel Core i3-4010U)

 Ram: 4 GB (Before 3 GB)

 GPU: AMD Radeon Vega 3 (Before AMD Radeon HD 7550M) or Intel HD 530 (Before Intel HD 4400) or Nvidia GT 730 (Before Nvidia GT 710)

 The rest is same (eg. Windows, HDD Space etc.)


Reccomended System Requirements now.


 CPU: AMD Ryzen 3 3200G (Before AMD A10 9600P APU) or Intel Core i3-10100 (Before i3 5010U)

 GPU: AMD Radeon Vega 8 (Before AMD Radeon R5 Graphics) or Intel UHD 630 (Before Intel HD 5500) or Nvidia GT 1030 (Before Nvidia GT 730)

 The rest is same (eg. Windows, HDD Space etc.)


Due to rising System Requirements, we will also gonna ship the Lite Version at launch, Lite Version is the lighter version of the game that supposedly can run on lower end PC and set top box computer.

We will put the Lite Version as Free DLC or Installing it via Beta Build (depending on which one is easier for the player) and based on internal testing at YSY Softworks test lab, the Lite version can run on a system as low as 2nd Gen Mobile Core i3 with onboard Intel HD 3000 GPU.

System Requirements for the Lite Version


 CPU: AMD A4 5000 APU or Intel Core i3-2350M
 Ram: 3GB Ram
 GPU: AMD Radeon HD 6450 / Intel HD 3000 / Nvidia GT 430


What's the difference between Regular and Lite? Why the system requirements for the Lite is very low compared to the Regular?

Regular version is using component known as PixiJS and Pixi Filter, while making the art and the colors more pop but the graphical improvement causing huge impact on the system.

While player can disabling the eye candy effect by change the graphics setting to "Low" and at low setting actually many PC even below the system requirements can run, but still on some older computer or lower end celeron some lag and hiccup occurs.

On the Lite version we not only disabling the PixiJS and Filter, we also disabling some of the animation, motion and extra effect. Making the game may look bit "generic" but should be playable 24+ fps even on 11 yrs old Laptop with Intel HD 3000 and Second gen Intel Core i3.

notes.title: Hi Tester! Welcome to CBT Program!
notes.content:
First, thank you for registering the CBT program, we really overwhelmed with the respond, we even not opening it via public on steam yet and the respond from social media already filled the limite amount of keys we have.

We'd like you to know some of known bugs so far. From tester CBT Batch 1 to Batch 3.


 On some choice scene like on the friendship menu after you unlock the guild, you can only use Up and Down but not Left and Right, this will be fixed on the next demo.

There is some text cropping issue, we already noted about this and will fix it as soon as possible.

This game still have some performance issue when "High Setting" turned on even when your computer meets the Minimum Requirements listed. We will update the minimum system requirements soon as more tester reporting their devices, this will help us determine more accurate system requirements.

Some passability issue like on the eggs will be fixed on next update.

Some icon issues will be fixed on the next demo. 

Battle Sprites positioning that looking bit weird, especially on Witham Forest, this will be fixed on the next scheduled update.


As for the Batch 1 to Batch 3 tester (who do live meeting with us From 14 Aug to 17 Aug) please check your email as we already send the reward as our token of thanks.
